'''The Syndicate'''<ref name="Quarters">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Quarters}}</ref> was a criminal organization that was ran on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] by [[Alina Impeveri]], during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was based in the [[Ishkik caverns]].<ref name="Holes" />
